tools.name: ingest_receiving_manifest
tools.description: Moves a supplier receiving manifest from the inbound drop folder into the processing folder, then runs the warehouse import script on it. Returns the script's exit status and output.

params.name: manifest_filename
params.description: File name of the manifest in the inbound drop folder, e.g. 'ASN_20261005_acme.csv'.

params.name: dock_code
params.description: Receiving dock identifier passed to the import script, e.g. 'D04'.

tools.name: pay_supplier_invoice
tools.description: Pays an outstanding supplier invoice for received stock by issuing a payout to the supplier's connected account. Returns the payment transfer ID.

params.name: supplier_account_id
params.description: The supplier's connected payment account ID, e.g. 'acct_1Nx...'.

tools.name: archive_discontinued_sku
tools.description: Moves a discontinued SKU's item record out of the active catalog table and into the archived items table. Refuses if the SKU still has on-hand stock.

params.name: sku
params.description: The SKU code to archive, e.g. 'WH-10442-BLK'.

params.name: reason
params.description: Short reason for discontinuation, stored with the archived record.

tools.name: record_cycle_count_adjustment
tools.description: Records a cycle count result for a bin location, updating the stored on-hand quantity and logging the variance. The adjustment is then posted to the ERP's inventory webhook.

params.name: counted_qty
params.description: Physically counted quantity in the bin.

params.name: counter_id
params.description: Employee ID of the person who performed the count.
